research: FreeCAD consumer gates and DWG-to-DXF loss attribution
type: primary-source review; no peer runtime executed
scope: Existing PAR-07/S8 and PAR-144 implementation/qualification gates

sources.finding: FreeCAD documents separate C++ and legacy Python DXF importers with different entity coverage; stock FreeCAD cannot read embedded ACIS/SAT solids. DWG import is converter-to-DXF followed by the selected DXF importer.
DWG requires an external converter; converter choice is configurable and FreeCAD then applies the DXF importer limitations.
Current source confirms the wrapper converts to DXF and calls importDXF.open; converter discovery/configuration is part of the exercised route.
Importer and converter behavior are selectable through preferences; reproducibility requires pinning these settings and preventing fallback to another converter.
LibreDWG reports AcDs DataStorage as incomplete and newer ACIS SAB extraction as brute-force, despite a named reader existing in current source.
Current source contains a named AcDsPrototype_1b section reader. Presence of a code path does not establish correct payload coverage or owner joins.
The public DXF-to-DWG-to-DXF loss reproducer does not isolate the DWG reader unless the intermediate DWG independently proves the writer emitted the section and payload.
ezdxf documents ASCII and Binary DXF read/write support across a broad version range; this is a DXF format comparator, not DWG or ACIS semantic evidence.
ezdxf's browse-acis command displays/exports raw SAT/SAB entity content.
ezdxf drawing explicitly does not render ACIS and has no 3D rendering engine.

plan_changes: Separate converter interoperability, chosen FreeCAD DXF importer behavior, and ACIS/B-rep semantics into three reportable qualification outcomes.
Require explicit converter path/version, FreeCAD build/platform, importer backend/preferences, output signature/hash, process diagnostics, and per-handle disposition in native qualification.
Treat stock FreeCAD ACIS as UNSUPPORTED_CONSUMER for the exact build, not as converter failure or failed libdxfrw semantic evidence.
Attribute ACIS loss at the first proven conversion stage; do not infer a reader gap without independently verified intermediate DWG section and payload bytes.
Keep per-slice checks focused and fast; perform native Linux/Windows runs only at the composed checkpoint, and self-unblock when those builds are unavailable.
